$comment: Pinned Remnic config for the FULL-FEATURE Tier-F pass (issue #1728, operator decision 2026-07-13: run both a baseline-profile pass, anchor-comparable with Tier L, and a real-profile pass measuring the shipped product). Used with `remnic bench run <locomo|longmemeval> --runtime-profile real --remnic-config <this file>`. The real profile preserves Remnic's shipped defaults (QMD hybrid search, knowledge index, entity retrieval, verified recall, Memory Boxes, contradiction detection, etc. per parseConfig defaults); this file pins ONLY the local-LLM endpoint so extraction and internal calls run on the lab GPU without environment-variable templating. Extraction gates stay at shipped defaults deliberately - this pass measures the product as shipped.
